items.stem: Which TWO are real challenges for recommender systems? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Cold start for new users or items with little data
options.rationale: Correct: sparse data makes recommendations hard.

options.text: Feedback loops that reinforce already-popular items
options.rationale: Correct: loops can narrow exposure over time.

options.text: Having any interaction data at all
options.rationale: Interaction data is an asset, not a problem.

options.text: Users being able to rate items

options.text: They cannot be computed from data
options.rationale: They are computed from data; the issue is validity.
